subject: Post-call: Deployment mode needs and PoC next steps
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme-corp.com>, Priya Mehta <priya.mehta@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: Deployment mode needs and PoC next steps

Hi Alex and Priya,

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and a proposed next steps plan so we can align on deployment mode and PoC scope.

Summary of deployment mode tradeoffs we discussed:
- Hosted API: fastest to get started, no infra changes, best for short evaluation timelines. Good if latency targets are modest and data residency is not restrictive.
- Dedicated capacity: reserved GPU pools for predictable throughput and isolation. Requires capacity reservation but gives consistent latency and easier scale for production.
- Private (VPC / on-prem): full network isolation and control, customer-managed networking and keys. Longer lead time due to security and networking onboarding.

Proposed PoC trial plan (flexible depending on your preference):
1) Hosted quick trial (1 week): validate model outputs against your test prompts, basic latency/cost signals.
2) Dedicated trial (2 weeks): pre-warmed reserved capacity with traffic shaping to validate p95 latency and throughput.
3) Private onboarding (6-8 weeks): security review, network setup, customer-managed keys, production readiness.

Suggested success criteria (please confirm):
- Latency: p95 < 200ms for 512-token requests under target concurrency (spec needed from your team)
- Throughput: sustained X requests/sec for peak workload (please share expected QPS)
- Quality: classification/intent accuracy > 92% on your evaluation set
- Cost: baseline cost per 1k tokens within agreed target for production budget

Next steps for us:
- You confirm preferred deployment mode for the PoC (hosted vs dedicated vs private)
- Share stakeholders for engineering, security, and procurement (names and emails)
- I will send a one-page PoC statement of work and a trial timeline once we confirm the above

Attachments: PoC_Checklist.pdf, Trial_Timeline.xlsx (stubs)

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
ben@redwoodinference.com

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme-corp.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Mehta <priya.mehta@acme-corp.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: Deployment mode needs and PoC next steps

Ben,

Thanks for the clear recap. After chatting with the team we are leaning toward Dedicated capacity for the PoC. Primary reasons: predictable latency and isolation from other tenants, and we expect sustained QPS that would benefit from reserved GPU pools.

A few questions and requests from our side before we lock in the plan:
- Can you share typical GPU profiles and expected throughput per GPU for the model flavors you recommended?
- What are the network egress and VPC requirements if we later decide to move to Private?
- Our initial estimated traffic for the PoC is 35 QPS with spikes to 70 QPS for short periods. We will confirm offline but want to use that for sizing.

I attached our internal requirements doc for context: ACME_requirements.docx

Attaching procurement and security contacts: security@acme-corp.com, procurement@acme-corp.com

Appreciate the quick turnaround on a proposed SOW and timeline.

Best,
Alex
Head of Product, Acme Corp
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme-corp.com>, Priya Mehta <priya.mehta@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2027 14:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: Deployment mode needs and PoC next steps

Alex, thanks for the direction. Dedicated makes sense given your QPS profile. Quick answers and a proposed dedicated PoC configuration: 

GPU profiles and throughput (typical):
- A100 80GB equivalent (heavy): best for long context and high throughput; ~1500 tokens/sec sustained per GPU for inference with batching (depends on request shape)
- A10G / L4 equivalent (balanced): good p95 latency and cost; ~600-900 tokens/sec per GPU
- We will size based on your request concurrency and token distribution (please share average tokens per request).

Proposed Dedicated PoC plan (2 weeks):
- Provision reserved pool: 2 GPUs balanced (start) with autoscale settings set to allow 1 additional GPU burst
- Pre-warm and run your synthetic replay and live test windows
- Metrics and SLOs we will measure: p50/p95 latency, error rate, throughput, cost per 1k tokens, model output regression against your eval set
- Success criteria: p95 < 200ms at 70 QPS on 512-token median; error rate < 0.5% on inference calls; acceptable output quality per your eval set.

Timing and dependencies:
- We can provision dedicated trial in ~10 business days after contract and PO (capacity permitting).
- If procurement needs a formal SOW we will provide a 1-page PoC SOW and a short term order.
- If security wants a checklist ahead of private onboarding we can run our standard security pack during the PoC.

I created a shared drive folder for the PoC plan: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cPoCPlan

Next: I will draft a short SOW and trial timeline and send for review. Marissa, looping you for the technical checklist and kickoff scheduling.

Thanks,
Ben
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme-corp.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Mehta <priya.mehta@acme-corp.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Nov 2027 09:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: Deployment mode needs and PoC next steps

Hi Alex, Ben,

Thanks for looping me in. From an SE perspective here is a short technical checklist I will use to prepare the PoC environment:
- Confirm average tokens per request and max tokens (for KV cache sizing)
- Provide a sample corpus of eval prompts and expected outputs (anonymized)
- Whitelisted IPs or secure tunnel info for test harness connectivity
- VPN / VPC peering details only if you opt for Private later (not required for Dedicated)
- SLA expectations and monitoring hooks (we ingest Prometheus traces / logs)

Proposed kickoff times next week (PST):
- Tue 23 Nov 2027 10:00-10:30 AM
- Wed 24 Nov 2027 2:00-2:30 PM
Please tell me which works and also include your security contact so we can run the security checklist in parallel.

I will prepare a pared-down PoC SOW that covers: scope, timeline, success criteria, and temporary trial pricing for the dedicated pool.

Regards,
Marissa
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme-corp.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@acme-corp.com, procurement@acme-corp.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2027 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: Deployment mode needs and PoC next steps

Thanks everyone. Confirming dedicated trial is the path we want to pursue. Stakeholders below:
- Product: Alex Johnson (me)
- Engineering: Priya Mehta (priya.mehta@acme-corp.com)
- Security: security@acme-corp.com (we will follow up with the named contact soon)
- Procurement: procurement@acme-corp.com

We have attached our security questionnaire for initial triage: ACME_Security_Questionnaire.pdf

Procurement is requesting a formal PoC/MAP and short SOW for internal approval. Can you send the SOW and a simple order form we can use for the trial? Once procurement signs we will issue a PO and you can schedule provisioning.

Appreciate the quick turnaround 1 looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Alex
